# BUILD_INDEX — the 46-ticket chain, one row per ticket (Phase A, read-only)

- **Produced:** 2026-09-08, planning-only session (ledger `.agents/scratch/NEXT-PHASE_planning-ledger_20260908.md` §5 Phase A, §10 MODE note). Nothing was changed in the repo; no `implement-spec`, no tests run.
- **Checkout at capture:** `devin/p18-2-france-belgium` @ `1baf05f` (2026-09-08 16:14 -0400), working tree clean except untracked `.devinignore`.
- **Sources (all read-only):** `gh pr list --state all --limit 100 --json …`; `git log --first-parent`, `git rev-list --count`, `git rev-parse` per branch; the 44 implement-spec ledgers in `.agents/scratch/` + `scratch/` (extracted by three parallel read-only subagents, spot-checked by hand where quotes looked wrong — see §A.6); PR bodies via `gh pr view N --json body` for tickets whose ledger is a stub; `docs/adr/ADR-*.md` `**Phase:**` field; `docs/risk_register.md` `## Phase …` headings; `docs/traceability.md` ticket-id mentions; `docs/tickets/*` `Depends on` lines.
- **Companion artifact:** `LEDGER_DEFERRALS.md` (same directory) — every non-met row, deviation, deferral, handoff seam, and "not run", with source path:line.

## A.4 Column notes

- **Trace.** `docs/traceability.md` is organised by theme (`## Crawler conduct (§26)` …), not by ticket; the count is `grep -o "P[0-9][0-9]\.[0-9]"` mentions. P00.1 has zero mentions (its requirements are stamped under stack/CI themes). Phase B should map ids → tickets via the PR bodies' "Requirement ids" tables, not via this file.
- **Risk §.** Phase 0 is one shared section (L6–60) for P00.1–P00.4 with P00.4-specific subsections at L45–60. **P08.1 has no risk-register section at all** (Phase 8 begins with P08.2) and no ADR — the resolver's deviations (if any) are undocumented in §53 → flagged for P19.2/P20.1. P13.1 has no ADR (none claimed).
- **ADRs.** Repo numbering (`docs/adr/ADR-NNN`) — 57 ADRs + README; 20 stack ADRs (001–020) belong to P00.2. Ledgers for P02.1, P05.1, P06.1, P16.2 cite **spec Appendix-F logical numbers** ("ADR-013", "ADR-016 = Splink", "ADR-024/025", "ADR-017") that differ from the repo numbers; the repo files are authoritative. Reconciling Appendix F ↔ repo numbering is Phase D input (`SPEC_RECONCILIATION_PLAN.md`).
- **Branch tips.** Merged tickets: tip = second parent of the merge commit on origin/main (all still exist locally except P02.1's). Open tickets: exactly one commit each except P14.1 (+ hardening commit `4493b14`, message in `.agents/scratch/p_analytics_hardening_commit.txt`, touching P12.1's `db/analytics.py` — i.e. a P12.1 fix landed on P14.1's branch; note for Phase D tagging and Phase E integration).
